analysis.title: 2027 Commodities Outlook: Adapting to Rough Waters (Webcast Slides)
key_insights: Goldman's estimate of the risk premium in Brent crude oil has dropped sharply (slide 2, source ICE and GS Global Investment Research). The slide text gives no level.
Supply adaptation is spreading across commodities but remains unequal, per slide 3 (Kpler data). The slide text does not say which commodities have adapted most.

Hedging recommendations for 2027: long the BCOM commodities benchmark (drivers: commodity supply concentration and disruption risk), long EBOB Jun27 European gasoline (lower gasoline production), and long call spreads on TTF 27Q1 for winter European gas (renewed geopolitical escalation risk and winter weather risk).

Trading recommendations for 2027: long gold London spot (central bank buying), long Dec-27 LME copper against short Dec-27 LME aluminium, and short 2029 European gas via long puts on TTF Summer 29 (long-dated oversupply).
In the copper/aluminium pair, copper is backed by electrification demand and mine constraints, while aluminium is the short on strong supply.
The deck contains a 2027 commodity price forecast table (slide 5). It is not in the extractable text, so no forecast levels are captured here.
